items.name: Driving
items.blurb: Cars, danfos and jeeps. Faster, grippier, kinder to your tyres.

branches.name: Street Racer
branches.desc: Speed and grip. For the Third Mainland boys.

perks.name: Heavy Foot
perks.desc: Cars go about 5 percent faster at the top end.

perks.name: Clean Line
perks.desc: Corners bite harder. Grip up 8 percent.

perks.name: Nitro Nerve
perks.desc: A big jump in top speed, but you drink more fuel.

perks.name: Third Mainland Ghost
perks.desc: Top speed and grip up again. They hear you after you pass.

perks.name: Pothole Whisperer
perks.desc: Potholes cost your tyres 20 percent less.

perks.name: Full Bus, Full Pocket
perks.desc: Fares up again, and mission pay up 5 percent.

branches.name: Fuel Saver
branches.desc: Petrol is not cheap. Make it last.

perks.name: Pothole Radar
perks.desc: Potholes cost your tyres 25 percent less.

perks.name: Long Haul
perks.desc: Less fuel and a bit more speed on the open road.

trains: Driving a car or danfo at speed

items.name: Riding
items.blurb: Okada and keke. Squeeze through the gap before it closes.

branches.name: Okada Rider
branches.desc: The fast lane is whichever lane is empty.

perks.name: Gap Finder
perks.desc: Grip and top speed both up.

perks.name: Express Rider
perks.desc: Fastest okada in Lagos, and fares pay more.

branches.name: Keke Boss
branches.desc: Three wheels, four passengers, one big smile.

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.desc: Three wheels stay planted. Grip up 10 percent.

perks.name: Park Chairman
perks.desc: The union respects you. Reputation gains up 20 percent.

perks.name: Ride in Rain
perks.desc: Wet roads hold you better. Grip up 10 percent.

perks.name: Trusted Courier
perks.desc: Mission cash and skill XP up.

items.name: Fighting
items.blurb: Fists, elbows and a good stance.

perks.name: Haymaker
perks.desc: Damage up 15 percent and a bigger knock-down chance.

perks.name: Scrap Instinct
perks.desc: Melee damage up 8 percent. Heal faster.

perks.name: Cornered Rat
perks.desc: Fast and mean. Cooldown down, damage up.

perks.name: Unmoved
perks.desc: Max health and regeneration up again.

items.name: Shooting
items.blurb: Guns are loud. Be accurate, be quick, be quiet.

perks.name: Spray and Pray
perks.desc: Damage up 8 percent, accuracy a little worse.

perks.name: No Fear
perks.desc: Reload very fast and hit a bit harder.

perks.name: Pocket It
perks.desc: Witnesses see you from 10 percent less distance.

perks.name: Alibi
perks.desc: Witnesses see you from 15 percent less distance again.

perks.name: Clean Getaway
perks.desc: Wanted cools fast and fines are lighter.

items.name: Trading
items.blurb: Buy low, sell high, never pay the first price.

branches.name: Haggler
branches.desc: The first price is a lie.

perks.name: Walk Away
perks.desc: Haggle rolls get a +1 level bonus.

perks.name: Oshodi Shark
perks.desc: Another +1 haggle level and cheaper buying.

perks.name: Contacts
perks.desc: Selling prices up 6 percent and trader rep gains up.

perks.name: Ladipo Kingpin
perks.desc: Selling and mission pay both up.

branches.name: Hustler
branches.desc: Small margins, many times a day.

items.name: Mechanics
items.blurb: Open the bonnet and listen. Cappa knows.

perks.name: Spray Master
perks.desc: Repairs need 12 percent less effort again.

perks.name: Tune Up
perks.desc: Your cars grip a little better.

perks.name: Full Rebuild
perks.desc: Repairs restore more, use less fuel after.

perks.name: Cappa Oga
perks.desc: Mechanic rep gains up and mission pay up.

items.name: Street Smarts
items.blurb: Know who to greet, who to avoid, and who to pay.

perks.name: Face Cap
perks.desc: Witnesses see you from 10 percent less distance.

perks.name: Blend In
perks.desc: Witnesses see you from 12 percent less distance again.

perks.name: Area Oga
perks.desc: Another talking level, more skill XP.

items.name: Charisma
items.blurb: Talk your way in, talk your way out.

perks.name: Straight Back
perks.desc: Witnesses see you from 5 percent less distance.

items.name: Stamina
items.blurb: Run further, recover quicker, take a beating.

items.name: Stealth
items.blurb: Crouch low, move slow, be gone before they look.

branches.name: Shadow
branches.desc: Guards see what they expect to see.

perks.name: Soft Steps
perks.desc: Guards notice you from 10 percent less distance.

perks.name: Dark Clothes
perks.desc: Guards notice you from 12 percent less distance again.

perks.name: Dead Still
perks.desc: Another 12 percent off the notice range.

perks.name: Ghost
perks.desc: Hard for guards to see at all.

perks.name: Pocket Sense
perks.desc: Witnesses see you from 10 percent less distance.

perks.name: Clean Hands
perks.desc: Witness distance and fines both down.

branches.name: Escape Artist
branches.desc: If they see you, be harder to catch.

items.name: Hacking
items.blurb: Terminals, POS machines and the odd forgotten password.

perks.name: Root Access
perks.desc: One digit shorter again and more time.

perks.name: Hidden Number
perks.desc: Witnesses see you from 5 percent less distance.

perks.name: Spoof
perks.desc: Guards notice you from 10 percent less distance.

perks.name: Phantom
perks.desc: Hack time, heat and sneaking all better.
